I will spread manure from my goats and cattle because it costs nothing, and I will buy one small bag of chemical fertilizer from the market to give the maize strength. I have kept seed from my own harvest last year, so I will plant that and save my money. We cannot afford pesticides or irrigation, so we will pull weeds by hand and wait for the rains. My wife and children will work with me on this plot, and we should manage everything ourselves without paying for hired help.
